title: A Smile for the Room
author: Emrys Reyes
blurb: Silas Winterbourne, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
